notes.title: Monthly update September 2025: Sparks are flying and... swimming?
notes.notes:
This month, we've been working on fleshing out the water mechanic. Water can now conduct electricity and can activate switches and other things in the level. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627602/21c2c258d2108084b642e75c244dc8a51bb0f663.gif"]

You might remember in the trailer, you could hotwire circuits by folding. This is an extension of that.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627602/83242376f0bfc3eef9ff43df11106ecd92311c52.gif"]



This turns water into both a useful tool and a dangerous obstacle that can kill you. We're excited to share the new puzzle opportunities this opens up. You can expect a new demo build mid August.

notes.title: Monthly update August 2025: From space-bending to water-bending
notes.notes:
We've been working steadily on new mechanics and puzzles after the demo. One of the new mechanics we're excited to share is the interactable water system!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627602/7c8a1c03e18562357705d78cd425ba90578969f7.gif"]

In the gif you can see the water being redirected by space folding to activate a waterwheel and open a gate. You'll be able to do a lot more with water in the full game and we can't wait to share more.

We're planning to update the demo with a new selection of levels in September. On that note, in case you missed it, the demo has had 3 new levels since the last public update! If you've completed the previous levels, you can try them instantly!

Lastly, we hit 3K+ wishlists recently  and we'd like to thank all the players for helping us come so far! If you'd like to follow the game's development, you can wishlist to be notified when it's updated.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627602/16ba6a20c0c5a1a2f812e099da950f8e9f56feea.png"]

notes.title: Compress(space) patch notes 6/3/25
notes.notes:
Patch notes:
1. We noticed some players struggling with the initial levels. We've updated them for a smoother experience
2. Tutorials and UI improved
3. Some people were unable to start the 1st level if they had an older save. This has been fixed.
4. Several level layouts updated.

We're still working on a bigger update with some new levels and mechanics!. If you find any bugs or have any suggestions, don't hesitate to use the feedback form!
